# Producer canary command — web-cfg has NOT announced a production POST of
# confenge.commercial_event.v1 on the real transport.
# inbound-handoff.cjs still posts confenge.inbound.v1 leads only.
# scripts/offers/events.cjs::commercialEvent() is the body factory (read-only).
#
# When the producer is live, POST a SYNTHETIC envelope on the HMAC route.
# Do not insert rows in SQL. Do not edit web-cfg from this campaign.
#
# Canonical URL:
#   https://api.confenge.com.br/api/v1/webhooks/confenge/inbound
# Loopback on the VPS (preferred for signed canaries):
#   http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/webhooks/confenge/inbound
#
# Header:
#   X-Warmbly-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex(hmac_sha256(secret, "<unix>." + body))>
#   Content-Type: application/json
#
# Body (schema/version must be confenge.commercial_event.v1; mark synthetic):

BODY='{"schema":"confenge.commercial_event.v1","version":"confenge.commercial_event.v1","event_id":"evt_SYNTHETIC_producer_canary_1","type":"offer_selected","occurred_at":"2026-08-20T16:00:00Z","offer_id":"CFG-DIAG-EXP-v1","offer_version":"v1","terms_version":"CFG-TERMS-B2B-2026-08-17-v1","external_reference":"SYNTHETIC-PRODUCER-CANARY-1","provider_event_id":"asaas_SYNTHETIC_producer_canary_1","amount_cents":800000,"currency":"BRL","source":"CONFENGE_WEB","revenue":false,"received_revenue":false,"synthetic":true}'
T=$(date +%s)
SIG=$(printf '%s.%s' "$T" "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$CONFENGE_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET" | awk '{print $2}')
curl -sS -D- -X POST "https://api.confenge.com.br/api/v1/webhooks/confenge/inbound" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "X-Warmbly-Signature: t=$T,v1=$SIG" \
  --data "$BODY"

# Expect: 201 created, replay of the same body 200 with replay=true.
# Follow with terms_accepted, checkout_created, payment_pending, payment_received
# using the same external_reference and unique event_id / provider_event_id.
# Then GET /v1/confenge/intel/executive?include_synthetic=1 and confirm by_offer_version.
# GET ...?include_synthetic=0 must not count it. Default INBOUND NOW must stay empty.
#
# Producer event_id -> HTTP receipt -> durable store -> reconciliation -> by_offer_version
# is NOT proven from web-cfg in this campaign.
